ollama_runtime_kv_investigation.findings: Prefix stability is structurally proven and establishes the exact invariant prefix required for engine-level KV cache reuse. However, direct KV-cache reuse latency reduction was NOT experimentally observed in Ollama Experiment B (prompt_eval_ms was 1071.02 ms vs 368.48 ms baseline). Ollama/llama.cpp runtime cache reuse under this harness did not yield an observed speedup, and no runtime cache speedup is claimed.
